Add a bike skills course to the existing Pine Trace Park. Install paved loop around the pond that can be used for walking or biking. Provide a pedestrian bridge that will provide access for both emergency and maintenance purposes from the park s main road onto the disc golf course. This will allow for quicker access to the center of the course, while avoiding the more heavily used portions of the park (playground, concessions area, kayak launch, fishing pier, Orange Trail
